description: PBT Seed Parser — parses structured [PBT-SEED] and [PBT-FAILED] output from test runners, extracts seed/test/status tuples, writes JSON log to data/pbt_seed_log.json

inputSample.stdin:
[PBT-SEED] seed=abc123 test=RaceConditionCheck status=PASS
[PBT-SEED] seed=def456 test=MemorySafety status=PASS
[PBT-FAILED] seed=ghi789 test=LogicCorrectness status=FAIL
